title: VERIFY T-444: replay under the rehearsal root, raw evidence, 3 mutants, live tree untouched
acceptance_criteria: Replay from clean and open the raw sandbox evidence (with --keep) for every newly fired row; the tool must have written it.

In throwaway copies, never the working tree: neuter attest.py forks to return nothing; remove the delegation ceiling check so a use beyond it succeeds; stop distinguish from recording a disposal. Each time the matching row must stop reporting fired.

Grep the script and test for any read of the operator's root key or of live private key material; confirm a rehearsal warrant fails verification in a scratch copy of the live tree; confirm git status and the .harness manifest are unchanged after a run.
Run the full suite via goal_mode, then verdict.

notes.note: Verification task for T-444 round 2, performed and recorded on T-444 itself (see T-444's VERIFIED note). All 4 acceptance criteria met: (1) replayed clean from a fresh run, raw sandbox evidence opened for each newly-fired row; (2) all 3 mandated mutants (forks()->[], delegation-ceiling raise removed, dispose_case() call removed) reproduced in throwaway copies outside the working tree -- each flips its matching row to blocked and fails exactly the matching 2 tests; the round-1 gap (dispose_case mutant escaping) is now fixed; (3) grep confirms no read of ~/.ssh/harness_root or live .harness/keys,trust,constitutional; RehearsalRootIsNotTheLiveRootTests passed (scratch-copy warrant refusal); git status/.harness manifest confirmed unchanged by this verifier's own actions; (4) full suite run via goal_mode.py reached GOAL on iteration 2/3 after one transient, non-persisting concurrency flake from another live agent writing to the shared board mid-run (reported, not a blocker).
